decision: Do not reduce model to nominal 3.31mm. Current 3.56mm accommodates drawing upper bound plus 0.10mm study assembly reserve; actual assembled envelope requires qualification. Low-profile alternative or stack/layout change remains necessary for the proposed 0.5mm battery/0.2mm roof reserves.

shell_stake.note: Model uses only top-side box and does not represent through-hole stake protrusions; check local battery/support/harness clearance and solder fillet before release.

mating.note: Verify case lip and cable overmold engagement against drawing; the rectangular connector cutout alone is insufficient.
